title: Dragon's Eye Quest
moral: Unity and pure intentions are stronger than greed.

scenes.summary: Captain Thorne begins the quest for the Dragon’s Eye.
scenes.text: Captain Thorne and his crew set sail to find a powerful magical jewel.
scenes.image_prompt: pirate crew sailing toward island with map, cartoon style

scenes.summary: They battle a rival pirate crew.
scenes.text: They fight Captain Vex and face a storm during battle.
scenes.image_prompt: two pirate ships battling in storm, action cartoon

scenes.text: They navigate jungle and temple puzzles to reach the treasure.
scenes.image_prompt: pirates exploring temple with traps and puzzles, colorful cartoon

scenes.summary: They face a magical spirit guarding the treasure.
scenes.text: They must prove their intentions are pure to claim the Dragon’s Eye.
scenes.image_prompt: ghost spirit guarding glowing jewel in temple, magical cartoon

scenes.summary: Both crews unite and share the treasure.
scenes.text: They work together and realize unity is more powerful than greed.
scenes.image_prompt: two pirate crews united holding glowing gem, peaceful cartoon

story: Captain Thorne and his crew journey to find the Dragon’s Eye, a powerful magical gem. They battle a rival crew and face storms before reaching a mysterious temple. There, they must prove their intentions are pure. By working together, even with their rivals, they succeed. They learn that unity and courage are more powerful than greed.
